title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government announce new AI tool to protect citizens against scams
description:
Share Copied The collaboration delivers an on-device scam detection model that helps protect citizens without compromising privacy.

Scams make up over half of Singapore’s reported crimes, and account for more than S$4 billion in losses since 2019. At the same time, scam tactics have shifted from simple phishing to complex social engineering, whereby attackers manipulate victims with convincing conversations before requesting money. Such scams now account for up to 80% of all losses.

description: Origin integrates with over 20 apps for deployments, CI, code review, security, monitoring, and project management, and the marketplace is now open to public submissions.

title: Origin 应用市场 · Cursor
description:
Origin 现已与 20 多款应用集成，涵盖部署、CI、代码审查、安全、监控和项目管理等领域，合作伙伴包括 Cloudflare、Linear、Sentry 和 Socket Security。

即日起，市场还将面向公众开放提交，任何构建开发者工具的团队都可以为 Origin 发布应用。

想构建 Origin 应用？不妨从 发布指南 和 Origin API 参考 入手。

Origin Apps 插件 还能基于实时的 Origin API 文档解答你的疑问，并为你现有的应用制定迁移到 Origin 的方案。
